## What problem does this solve?

A clear and concise description of what the current tool is missing or could do better.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like. If you have a specific implementation idea, include it here.

## Which area does this affect?

- [ ] Collector / OEM adapter
- [ ] Compatibility or security evaluation
- [ ] HCL / BCG correlation
- [ ] Report or export
- [ ] Browser UI
- [ ] CLI (new `--flag` or output format)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought of.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, Redfish captures, VCF documentation links, or anything else relevant.
